text:
Kevin: Heads up — saw a sudden uptick in per-token spend for route 'chat/gen' starting ~09:12 UTC, +18% overall.
Kevin: Dashboard shows cache savings dropped and more fallbacks to the high-cost model variant; latency spiked a bit too.
Lina: Ugh. Can you paste the query IDs or a screenshot? which tenant affected?
Kevin: Mostly across multiple tenants but heavy on tenant=search-service. Query id sample: q_afe23b
Munir: Any deploys around then? OpsBot, did anything roll? :eyes:
OpsBot: deploy:api-router service v3.14.2 -> v3.14.3 at 09:08 UTC by ci/bot
Sara: Hmm router change could've affected batching logic or route affinity.
James: Could also be prefetch/cache crediting miscalc. If cache credits didn't apply we fall back to model-xlarge.
Kevin: I dug into the batcher logs. Saw a bunch of 'batcher.drain_timeout' in the 09:11-09:15 window and a few 'kvcache_miss' warnings.
Kevin: Example log snippet:
```
INFO batcher: bundle_id=bdl-123 drain_timeout=120ms route=chat/gen model_prefetch=on
WARN kvcache: tenant=search-service key=prompt-sha256 miss
```
Munir: Ok that suggests the router change changed batching deadlines for certain tenant affinity buckets.
Lina: We don't have a per-route batcher deadline metric in the console yet — that makes debugging painful.
Sara: We should add a temporary dashboard card: batcher.drain_time distribution + fallback-rate by model_variant for the route.
James: Also add a sampling probe to capture full request headers for 1% of traffic around those tenants to confirm route tags.
Munir: Quick mitigation: roll back v3.14.3 to v3.14.2 for the router, or add a routing override to force sticky batching for search-service.
Kevin: I'd prefer a targeted override to avoid full rollback. Can someone flip a runtime flag? `router.sticky_affinity=true` for tenant=search-service.
OpsBot: runtime flag change requested by Kevin at 09:28 UTC -> applied to cluster-alpha
Kevin: After flag flip cache savings recovered within 4 minutes for the sample tenant. numbers look better.
Lina: Action items:
- Lina: add batcher.drain_time and fallback-rate per-route chart to the econ dashboard (hotfix tile)
- James: add 1% sampled header capture + store to s3 for 72h (forensics)
- Munir: propose a routing test in staging to simulate v3.14.3 changes and measure batcher effects
- Sara: draft rollback/runbook note in the release doc for v3.14.x
Kevin: I'll follow up with a short postmortem if numbers hold.
Sara: Also let's add an alert: if cache_savings drop >10% for a route for >5m trigger paging.
James: Ack. I'll bake that into the console alert rule template.
Munir: FYI we should also evaluate moving per-route batcher metrics into the per-tenant telemetry ingest so console can slice faster.
Kevin: Great. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
